name: com.miteksystems.misnap.workflow.MiSnapWorkflowActivity
description: Alviere's alCamera package includes Mitek MiSnap capture workflows. When the app starts a configured workflow, this screen guides the user through document, face, barcode, or NFC capture and returns a result or error.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete MiSnap document or face capture, or barcode and NFC steps in the same workflow.
